chunks: Some among the people of the Book wish to lead you astray, yet they lead none astray but themselves, though they do not realise.
ai.seo_question: Who are the people of the Book that wish to lead believers astray and what is the result?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the hypocritical faction among the Jews and Christians who outwardly claimed affinity with the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to gain political advantage, yet inwardly sought to lead the faithful astray. Their self-deception illustrates the concept of 'ghurur' (deception), where their attempts to obscure the truth ultimately result in their own spiritual ruin, a theme resonating with the Ahl al-Bayt's emphasis on inner sincerity over outward conformity.
